wiki.title: Jay Morris
wiki.extract: John Clyde Morris III (born May 24, 1958) is a businessman and attorney from Monroe who has been a member of the Louisiana State Senate for the 35th district in North Louisiana since 2020. A Republican, from 2012 until 2020, Morris was a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives from District 14, which encompasses Ouachita and Morehouse parishes in the northeastern portion of his state.
